body.text:
Keep specs, plans and decisions in the repository as records
that agents can find from the task they are working on.

A relic ID is `<KEY>-R-<ULID>`. A part is `<relic>#<part>`.

- **Decided:** Relics live under their own refs. Each relic is one ref
  under `refs/workbook/relics/`.
- Part IDs never change once given.

Two saves of one body are never merged. The second is refused
or reported as a conflict, and nothing is lost. A save names the
version it started from with `--base`.
